title: Health Plan Clean Provider Delegation Standard
content: Providers with active unencumbered state licenses, board certification, and zero sanction matches across OIG/SAM/NPDB qualify for clean stream processing and auto-approval recommendation.

title: Health Plan Exception Escalation Policy
content: Providers with past expired licenses (resolved), minor administrative board inquiries, or single malpractice claims without adverse findings are routed to Committee Review as Exception cases.

title: Health Plan Hold and Denial Protocol
content: Providers with active federal sanctions (OIG LEIE exclusion, SAM debarment) or active state license suspensions MUST be placed on Hold and recommended for Network Denial.
